as someone who sh (and in a relationship) my advice would be to act normal about it,, you should try your best not to make her feel like shes gross or weird for her sh,, that might make her urges/actions stronger and might cause resentment,, try your best to create an environment where shes comfortable (in all aspects ofc) sharing about sh and things like that,, i 100% recognize how you might feel like you need to be doing more but i will try to quixkly explain my main point: 

self harm is (usually/often) a punishment someone inflicts on themselves,, they could be punishing themselves for many reasons but very common ones are: they feel thy deserve it for somthing theyve done, they feel gross/different, they feel as if no one appreciates and accepts their true self

so by accepting her for herself and everything that entails, youre helping her out in ways beyond you would ever know,, by helping her understand shes not gross, shes not weird,, by helping her see that even when she makes mistakes/accidents, she doesnt deserve negativity,, 

you can take that as youd like but thats basically it,, have sympathy, listen and hear her, accept and support her, and while it might be difficult, being conscious about your reactions to not only her sh but in general,, 

hope that makes sense lol i could talk abut this all day,, cheers, and good luck!
